preprocessing: FP32 log1p(rawcount *8261.5 / raw total); input-positive full genes; real log-total, detected-features/total, mitochondrial UMI fraction from MT- symbols,23 source-lane indicators; no reference data

pilot_steps.validation_objective: Full native normal_loss on entire3250-cell split; no batching or KL substitution

readout_policy: Resource pilot does not compute rankings or save biological effect scores. Native continuous and thresholded readout/ID adapters are separately checked in implementation smoke. Any future scored fit requires its own convergence and locked full-input-refit gates.

measurement.memory: Worker-internal resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF), not proxy PID; 100ms guard telemetry; parent records its independent proxy measurement but never substitutes it
measurement.time: Wall clock for20 native training batches plus one full-size native validation call; record each batch time and validation time separately
measurement.forecasts: Expected complete epochs =ceil(22750/100)=228 batches plus one validation call; extrapolate250 and500 epochs as forecasts, not measured convergence
measurement.full_benchmark_qualification: Pilot cannot certify convergence. It can show resource inability or establish eligibility for later adequately budgeted fitting.

continue_rule: Width700 must finish full native validation below6.5GiB and predict250 epochs <=12h. Width1000 follows only if dedicated capacity remains; an unavailable width cannot be called beaten. Retain every failure.
metadata_precondition: Await D3-only metadata owner release for actual NTC lane and fullaxis MT annotation, then prepare_gperturb_real_input.py writes a hash-bound REAL_D3_INPUT_MANIFEST; no placeholder covariates allowed.
failure_interpretation: Resource guard, OOM, native numerical exception or inadequate convergence is not a method-performance loss.
